simple.meaning: עָצַם (ʻâtsam) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to bind fast , i.e. close (the eyes); intransitively, to be (causatively, make) powerful or numerous ; to crunch the bones.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 20 times across Genesis, Exodus, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 26:16. Its contexts include offering, sacrifice, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָצַם (H6105).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָצַם (ʻâtsam) / H6105 is traced through Genesis 26:16, Exodus 1:7, Exodus 1:20, Psalms 38:20 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to bind fast , i.e. close (the eyes); intransitively, to be (causatively, make) powerful or numerous ; to crunch the bones
definitions.usage: break the bones, close, be great, be increased, be (wax) mighty(-ier), be more, shut, be(-come, make) strong(-er).
definitions.full: H6105. atsam I. Hiph`il make strong, Imperfect 3masculine singular: suffix וַיַּעֲצִימֵחוּ Psa 105:24 + מִן compare II. [ עָצַם ] verb shut the eyes (Late Hebrew Hiph`il; possibly connection with Syriac = id. , Arabic , IV (on = see Nö ZMG xxxii (1878), 406 ); Late Hebrew עִמֵּץ close eyes of dead; compare Ba ES 5f. ); — Qal Participle מִן עֵינָיו וְעֹצֵם Isa 33:15 shutteth his eyes from seeing Pi`el Imperfect 3masculine singular אֶתעֵֿינֵיכֶם וַיְעַצֵּם Isa 29:10 he hath tightly shut your eyes (compare I. עצה ).

occurrences.englishText: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”
The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.
They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me,
Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire.
Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me.
God, you know my foolishness.
He increased his people greatly,
How precious to me are your thoughts, God!
For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.
Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help,
He who walks righteously

Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.
Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas.
All your lovers have forgotten you.
Why do you cry over your injury?
“Israel is a hunted sheep.
The male goat magnified himself exceedingly. When he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.
His power will be mighty, but not by his own power. He will destroy awesomely, and will prosper in what he does. He will destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.
After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up, and will become strong, with a small people.
